trials.claim: Lifetime access lasts for lifetime of product not guaranteed duration
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime deals provide access for the lifetime of the product, not a guaranteed duration.
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit says a licence delivers updates for protocol changes, but it does not define how long lifetime access lasts or show lifetime buyers lose access.

exhibits.quote: The licence is what keeps it current with the specification: protocol changes, transport deprecations and client handshake updates all ship through product updates and support.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows continued functionality depends on an active licence for updates, contradicting guaranteed lifetime access.

trials.claim: 200 site limit counts active sites only
trials.claimQuote: Yes, the limit of 200 sites is for the number of active sites.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about whether the 200-site limit counts only active sites.

trials.claim: One site equals one installation not one user or connection
trials.claimQuote: A site means one GetMCP installation, not one user or one MCP connection.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence defining a site as one installation rather than a user or connection.

trials.claim: Buyers get all future LTD plan updates mapped to plan
trials.claimQuote: All future LTD Plan updates that map to your plan
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit warns a server can stop working without a licence, but it does not show lifetime-deal buyers are denied future LTD plan updates or moved to a paid licence.

exhibits.quote: Without it, a server that worked yesterday can quietly stop being callable tomorrow.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows future updates and operability stop without an active licence, undermining promise of all future LTD updates.

trials.claimQuote: A plugin update handles the churn for you.
trials.reasoning: The defense exhibit directly says that when the MCP specification changes, a product update applies the new protocol and tools keep working. The other exhibits do not directly contradict that update mechanism.

exhibits.quote: The licence is what keeps it current with the specification: protocol changes, transport deprecations and client handshake updates all ship through product updates and support.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows protocol churn is only handled if licence is current, contradicting claim that a plugin update alone handles it.

exhibits.quote: We strive to maintain high availability of the Service but do not guarantee uninterrupted access.
exhibits.argument: Quote disclaims guarantee of uninterrupted service, undermining promise that updates will keep tools working through churn.

exhibits.quote: When the MCP specification changes, a product update applies the new protocol and your tools keep working.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms a product/plugin update handles MCP protocol changes so tools keep working.

trials.claim: 30-day money-back guarantee with no exceptions after
trials.claimQuote: 30-day money-back guarantee, no matter the reason. No exceptions thereafter
trials.reasoning: The refund terms limit refunds for renewal payments and list situations that are not eligible for a refund, which materially limits the claim of a guarantee with no exceptions.

exhibits.quote: Renewal payments: refunds are available only for the first 30 days after your initial payment. Subsequent renewal charges are not eligible.
exhibits.argument: Quote creates an exception for renewal payments, contradicting the no exceptions claim.

exhibits.quote: The following situations are not eligible for a refund:
exhibits.argument: Quote introduces a list of refund exceptions, directly contradicting no exceptions thereafter.

exhibits.quote: we offer a straightforward 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans.

exhibits.quote: No questions asked. No hoops to jump through. If it is not right for you, we will make it right.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms guarantee is no-questions-asked with no exceptions within window.

droppedExhibits.reason: not found: "a flat annual licence with no per-call fees and no usage gat"
